title: Auto Fish Auto Reel Auto Sell Hitbox Expander And More
features:
[+] Auto Fish
[+] Target Mode (Closest, Furthest, Specific Types)
[+] Specific Fish Types (Multi-Select)
[+] Refresh Fish Types
[+] Auto Reel
[+] Low Oxygen Slider
[+] Return to Lobby When Oxygen is Low
[+] Zone Teleport (Ancient Sands, Forgotten Deep, Spirit Roots)
[+] Teleport to Zone
[+] NPC Teleport
[+] Refresh NPCs
[+] Teleport to NPC
[+] Sell All
[+] ESP Enable/Disable
[+] ESP Show Boxes
[+] ESP Show Tracers
[+] ESP Show Names
[+] ESP Show Distance
[+] ESP Show Fish Type
[+] ESP Filter By Type
[+] ESP Fish Types Filter (Multi-Select)
[+] ESP Refresh Fish Types
[+] ESP Max Distance (100-5000 studs)
[+] ESP Box Thickness (1-5)
[+] ESP Tracer Thickness (1-5)
[+] ESP Text Size (10-24)
[+] ESP Tracer Origin (Top, Center, Bottom)
[+] Change Font
[+] Anti-AFK
[+] Noclip (Auto-enabled with Auto Fish)

comments.text: Muy bueno, pero podrías agregar algo para el evento de san Valentín
